name: Everlasting Torment
oracle_text:
Players can't gain life.
Damage can't be prevented.
All damage is dealt as though its source had wither. (A source with wither deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.)
blocked_sentences: All damage is dealt as though its source had wither. (A source with wither deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.)

needs.what: a global static (affects_player any) under which every prevention effect -- prevent_damage statics, prevent_damage / prevent_damage_permanent / prevent_combat_damage shields, protection's damage prevention -- is not applied to any damage dealt while the permanent is on the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has prevent_damage, prevent_all_but and protection, all of which ADD prevention; nothing switches prevention off. The packet notes say outright that "Damage can't be prevented" is a different effect from cant_gain_life, and no static or op in reference names it

needs.what: a global static making all damage to creatures, from every source (spells, abilities, permanents in any zone, both players'), be dealt as -1/-1 counters, as though each source had wither
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the wither keyword exists, but a grant_keyword static can only grant it to permanents matched by affects, so damage from instants, sorceries and other non-permanent sources would still be marked normally; replace_damage only scales the amount (damage_multiplier/damage_addend) and cannot change how damage is dealt
